gbm_population_evidence.quote: Suspected glioblastoma with contrast-enhancement in preoperative MRI

coder_notes: Surgical trial (anterior temporal lobectomy vs gross total resection); no drug or biologic interventions. Inclusion is by suspected glioblastoma / diffuse high-grade glioma on frozen section; the primary analysis population is defined as CNS WHO grade 4 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma in the outcomes, hence cns5. IDH-wildtype appears only as an analysis-population definition, not an entry requirement, so not recorded as a biomarker. Control is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm.
